root_cause: The LinkedIn company same-day recovery escaped repository authority in four layers: company identity was still compared against a hardcoded person id instead of the provider-verified setup state; same-claim uniqueness required raw-hash/story-fingerprint identity even when normalized content was identical; expired unconsumed publication capabilities remained behind the daily unique fence; and exact company readback treated LinkedIn URL/escaping normalization as a material content mismatch. The existing reconciliation path also left an otherwise fully proven company obligation at PUBLISHED instead of LIVE_PROVEN.
prevention_rule: Production and source must share one contract: bind company identity to personal_author_urn from the fresh proof-bound setup account; treat the same daily claim as idempotent only when normalized_hash is exactly equal; auto-revoke only expired unconsumed capability leases while consumed capabilities remain the daily side-effect fence; require exact post id, organization author and PUBLISHED lifecycle plus exact canonical normalized commentary; and promote the publication obligation to LIVE_PROVEN only when provider truth, fresh organization OAuth, admin proof and organization-write verification are all true.
